diagnosis: Diagnostic algorithm for the integrated histomolecular endometrial carcinoma (EC) classification
legend: The algorithm can be applied to all EC histotypes including carcinosarcomas and other rare types of EC. MMR, mismatch repair; dMMR, mismatch repair–deficient; NSMP, no specific molecular profile. The MMR status is assessed with immunohistochemistry for MMR proteins (MLH1, PMS2, MSH2, and MSH6), and p53 immunohistochemistry is a surrogate marker for TP53 mutational analysis. Note that POLEmut ECs have a pathogenic exonuclease domain POLE mutation regardless of abnormal staining for DNA MMR proteins and/or p53. dMMR ECs show abnormal immunohistochemical expression of one or more DNA MMR proteins in the absence of a pathogenic POLE mutation, with or without abnormal p53 expression.
